column1: # How much the hard call would move if the cut were placed anywhere between the R10 valley
# (0.4470) and the published cut (0.508). A deep valley means few read-units sit in that
# band, so the call is insensitive to where exactly the cut falls.
# RESULT: the band holds 1.208% of read-units overall and 1.246% / 1.179% / 1.160% in R9 /
# R10 / unknown - the same share in every stratum. The low-methylation fraction changes by
# at most 1.25 percentage points. The chemistry split does not drive the hard call.
